raw_response:
I cannot afford chemical fertilizer this season, and since beans fix their own nitrogen, I will rely on the manure from our few goats and chickens to give the soil some strength. I will plant the improved cowpea seed I kept from last season because it matures faster and the pod borer has been terrible, so I must buy a small amount of insecticide to save the crop. The rains should be enough, so I will not irrigate, but I will need to hire a few extra hands from the village when it is time to harvest quickly before the pods split.
